rounding: round intermediate dimension and signal scores to 1 decimal; round modeled revenue to whole dollars

rules: customer_id and ISO contract_end_date are required
arr must be greater than zero
licensed_seats must be greater than zero and active_seats must be between zero and licensed_seats
an unadopted module must have usage_pct equal to zero; all usage_pct values must be between zero and 100
previous_period must include usage_score, engagement_score, support_score, relationship_score, and overall_score
data_quality.handling: Exclude any failing record from scores, rollups, and action queues; list it once in human review with every observed issue.

health_model.normalization: positive metric = clamp(value/segment target*100); inverse metric = clamp((1-value/segment maximum)*100)
health_model.trend: improving when current minus previous is greater than 5; declining when less than -5; otherwise stable

churn_model.usage_decline: login risk=clamp(abs(min(login_trend,0))*3), feature risk=*4, DAU/MAU risk=*500; combine 40%/35%/25%
churn_model.engagement_drop: cancellation risk=clamp(count*25), response risk=clamp((days-1)*15), NPS risk=clamp(abs(min(change,0))*20); combine 30%/35%/35%
churn_model.support_issues: escalation risk=clamp(count*35), critical-ticket risk=clamp(count*50), satisfaction improving/stable/declining/critical=10/30/70/95; combine 35%/35%/30%
churn_model.days_basis: calendar days from snapshot_date; past dates are zero days

expansion_model.seat_rule: when active/licensed is at least 90%, estimated revenue is ARR times segment factor
expansion_model.tier_rule: recommend the next available higher multiplier; incremental revenue = ARR/current multiplier*target multiplier - ARR
expansion_model.module_rule: each unadopted non-core module is a cross-sell; adopted modules below 30% need enablement and are not sales opportunities
expansion_model.department_rule: each potential department not already current is estimated at ARR/max(current department count,1)*0.8
expansion_model.priority: clamp(revenue/2000,0,100) multiplied by low/medium/high effort factor 3/2/1

triage.intervention_eligibility: health is red OR churn tier is high or critical OR any warning signal is critical
triage.intervention_rank: descending effective severity (a critical warning is treated as critical), then renewal within 30 days, then declining overall health, then ARR, then customer_id
triage.expansion_eligibility: health is green AND churn tier is low AND no warning signal is high or critical AND at least one modeled opportunity exists
triage.expansion_rank: descending total estimated expansion revenue, then customer_id
triage.guardrail: an account may never appear in both action queues
